unsupported: ЗМДТ read in the Ministry of Finance's English text (minfin.bg, as amended to SG 8/2022; Internet Archive 2024-09-12): the surviving spouse and lineal heirs pay no inheritance tax (чл. 31 ал. 2); siblings and their children pay 0,4 to 0,8 % and all others 3,3 to 6,6 % of each share above BGN 250 000 (чл. 36); gifts: 0,4 to 0,8 % between siblings and their children and 3,3 to 6,6 % otherwise, on the assessed value (чл. 47 ал. 1), none between spouses or lineal relatives (чл. 44 ал. 6).
